source.citation: Project owner, Glessner House version 4 reconstruction brief, 29 September 2026: correct intersecting roofs, courtyard and garden-level openings, continuous copper roof at the inner northeast corner, variable-height ashlar courses, and east-wing chimneys. Follow-up 1 October 2026: rebuild west-wing roof, gables and dormer from northwest/west views; carve the north entrance alcove with left-turn steps and door against HABS floor plans. Later 1 October correction: continuous rear ridge, balanced solid south gable and courtyard eave matching the north range. Follow-up 2 October 2026: correct north windows protruding through the eave; rebuild the whole west elevation to the supplied square-on reconstruction, including stone courses, openings, low rear roof, hood, gutters and turret-to-gable alignment; assess north stone appendage and doors. Follow-up 7 October 2026: remove the recessed cuts beside the courtyard dining tower; connect its copper hip to the north roof with raised tiled slopes and matching ridge adornment. Follow-up 8 October 2026: raise the courtyard dining-tower upper glazing to align with the north-wing upper windows, shortening the copper cap while retaining period-appropriate sash divisions. Follow-up 9 October 2026 UTC: correct the front west gable angle and rear section width against the supplied west and northwest images, then validate against both photographs before merging to dev. Later 9 October correction: restore the west wing's full-height level ridge, simple front and rear gables, and matching courtyard awning; the lowered rear roof and exposed courtyard wall are a regression.
what_it_does_not_supply: A measured survey or a dated 1904 view.
Reusable photographic textures or permission to redistribute third-party reference images.
Exact dimensions, colour, roof patina, plantings, or a pre-1946 date for an otherwise undocumented opening.
what_it_supplies: The owner-requested visible omissions to correct in version 4.
Qualitative cross-check that a cross gable, west-wing courtyard windows, garden-level lights and a continuous corner copper roof should not be omitted.
T-1830 owner request and qualitative roof/entrance comparisons; first- and second-floor HABS plans supply dimensional control.
T-1833 owner-directed south-gable and matching courtyard-eave reconstruction, superseding the prior rear hip.
T-1999 controlling west-elevation reconstruction and explicit turret alignment; supersedes conflicting T-1833 rear-roof height assumptions.
T-2157 courtyard dining-roof reconstruction: forward copper hip, raised tiled connector, continuous host eave and matching crest.
